classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume reads each index file once inside a loop that aborts with missed=True when probe.NS()-started exceeds the budget_ns broadcast from the producer time, and every rank is held at the per-unit barrier.wait() (and barrier.broadcast) until that staging finishes.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report re-reads each statistics file once per pass for STATISTICS_READS=8 passes with no budget check, and the consumer cannot reach the closing barrier.wait() -- which holds all producers and idle ranks -- until those reads complete.
